msg: Keep your hands on the 's', 'k' and space keys as it's important to make sure you make a selection in 1.5 seconds. If you don't you'll get 0 points on that go.The only pattern I noticed was that the colour of the gnomes determines what colour basket you will see. The brown and maroon/red gnomes will lead to a red basket and the grey/green and purple gnomes will lead to a yellow basket.There was possibly some pattern, where if a basket gave 5 or more mushrooms it was best to stick with that colour basket for the next selection. If it was 4 or less two goes in a row then it was best to select the other colour basket. If that also only had 4 or less mushrooms I then switched to the other colour again and so on until I got 5 or more mushrooms.As there are either 0-9 mushrooms and 200 goes, the average score would be 900 (assuming the number of mushrooms in each basket is random). With the tactics I used I got almost 1000 mushrooms, which is better than average. Whether that was by chance or not I don't know.
